reviews.text: My dog ​​came out much better thanks

Families and pet owners should take notice before bringing their animals here. I will never go back.
I was deeply upset by the way my corgi was handled. The technician was harsh and held him tightly around the neck in a way that made me fear for my dog’s safety. There was no gentleness, patience, or compassion. I would not feel safe leaving my dog alone with him behind closed doors.
When I expressed concern, I was told, “You get what you pay for.” That was shocking, dismissive, and completely unprofessional—especially from someone caring for a beloved family pet.
They say they open at 8:00 a.m., yet when I arrived at 8:00, I was told I would have to wait until they were ready. If you advertise that you open at 8:00, customers should not be treated as though they are inconveniencing you by arriving then. On top of that, the vaccines were very expensive.
I had been a loyal customer and expected basic kindness and respect for both me and my dog. Instead, I left feeling disturbed and disappointed. Your pets deserve compassionate, careful treatment. Please think carefully before taking an animal you love to Santis.

Brought my cat in because he wasn’t eating or drinking. Turns out he had pancreatitis. He was treated at this clinic and quickly went back to normal. Everyone was professional and we had a good experience. The costs for bloodwork, fluids, and medication were about $600-700

There's always a long wait; it's not a place to go in an emergency. It's a bit uncomfortable that sick dogs defecate in the waiting room, where healthy dogs are also waiting for vaccinations, and the area isn't cleaned properly.
I think the check-up is very basic; they spend more time on the paperwork than on the actual examination. They also give incorrect diagnoses. We told them my dog ​​had recurring itching, and they said it was from the grass. We said there wasn't any, and they said it was from the concrete, but we keep him inside. "Ah, then it's hereditary," they said, and prescribed medicine without being sure of the cause. The price is reasonable, not cheap, but not outrageous either.
The best clinic, excellent service, and a very professional doctor. I would highly recommend it. I have two dogs, and they always receive excellent care. Highly recommended.

We have no words to thank Dr. Santi Bañez and the entire team at Santi Pet Clinic.

Thor and Loki have always been patients at this clinic, but one night we had to rush to an emergency hospital because Santi Pet Clinic was already closed. There, we received a devastating diagnosis: we were told that Thor needed emergency exploratory surgery or that we should consider euthanasia.

As soon as the clinic reopened, we rushed to seek a second opinion from Dr. Santi. From the very first moment, he provided the calm, empathy, and professionalism we so desperately needed. After carefully examining Thor, his diagnosis was completely different: he didn't need emergency surgery. With the right treatment, our puppy was able to recover.

Today, Thor is still with us, full of life and energy, and getting into all the mischief of a happy puppy.
